description.en: A 25 km light-rail line between Itäkeskus in Helsinki and Keilaniemi in Espoo. Construction began in June 2019 and passenger service began on 21 October 2023. The Helsinki and Espoo infrastructure outturn was reported as EUR 382 million, including a warranty-period reserve.

cost.note: The reported infrastructure outturn includes a EUR 7 million reserve for costs during the warranty period. The depot outturn of EUR 63 million and EUR 67.5 million of related works are separate. The source does not state a price year.

note.en: The OSM route geometry measures 24.24 km, about 3% below the published approximate length of 25 km. The official figure is retained.
